featured_reviews.review_text:
Having met Aku from the SlumGods crew – a hip-hop collective empowering children through teaching them the elements of hip-hop in Dharavi, during the #sassoondockartproject, @guidovanhelten spent sometime in Dharavi, making photographs, and understanding more about the space through the eyes of Aku and his friends who gave him a first hand sense of the vibrant street culture of Dharavi.

The artist decided he wanted to paint two boys, Bboy Pro kid and Bboy Abhishek, framed mid-action doing what they do best … dance!

The mural is a representation of the future of youth culture and the strength of creativity and expression in Dharavi through dance, graffiti and hip hop culture. It is reflective of the emerging and contemporary face of Dharavi.

It is a must visit place for everyone to witness the mural in person

featured_reviews.name: Swati Waghmare
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had booked this hall for my niece's birthday. We had to settle for this one since it was too last-minute that we decided to celebrate her birthday. It is a small hall that can accommodate around 30 people and has an open-space outside the hall where one can set up a buffet for one's event. This hall is inside Karnatak Society (Marunga) and is basically a room or a flat that they have converted into a hall to generate extra income for their society.
Having said that, this particular space comes with a lot of baggage which they don't mention or divulge during the time of booking. First, they told us that medium music is allowed, but when we started playing the music(less than medium) an aged uncle turned up out of nowhere and started screaming at the one who was playing music in the staging area. He literally threatened him that he'll stop the event and that he'll do a police complaint and blah-blah before leaving the premises. Post which they never allowed us to play the music (even minimum) and we had to bear the cost of the DJ. Second, the air conditioner – it is a rectangular room like a long lane and the air conditioner (just one) is set up at the extreme end of the room that doesn't even cool the entire room. And it is only for 2 hours. For every extra hour, they charged us Rs. 500/-. The charges of the room are Rs.8000/- (too expensive given the amenities and the size) along with the deposit to which he told us that we will be charged extra Rs. 15/- for every table we use (we needed tables for setting up the buffet) along with additional Rs. 300/- as cleaning charges. Third, the people are extremely rude and want to make money out of everything. Fourth, while we were decorating the place for the birthday party they told us not to stick any balloons on the walls (also not mentioned during the time of booking the hall).
All in all a worst experience. I'll suggest not to book this place for any event, even the small ones.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful stay at Flora Eco Stay Resort & Spa. The resort is surrounded by beautiful greenery and offers the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and nature. The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-maintained, making it an ideal destination for a relaxing weekend getaway in Lonavala.

The staff was courteous, attentive, and always ready to help. The food was delicious, with a good variety of options like Aam Ras puri, poha, Upma and their refreshing kokum shariat. The spa experience was truly rejuvenating. Takes away all your aches and pains of our  busy city lifestyle. The peaceful atmosphere, scenic views, and excellent hospitality make this one of the best eco-friendly resorts in Lonavala for couples, families, and anyone looking to unwind away from the city.

They also have a lot of indoor activities like carrom, snakes and ladder, business game, housie and some interesting books to read.

If you’re searching for a nature resort in Lonavala with great amenities, comfortable accommodation, a relaxing spa, and exceptional service, Flora Eco Stay Resort & Spa is an excellent choice. Highly recommended for staycations, family vacations, romantic getaways, and wellness retreats.

Thanks to the staff and the owner Narendra and his wife for the wonderful job they are doing.

Like their funny insta videos they are all lively and put their heart to what they do and they are all customer centric.

featured_reviews.name: Reshi Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best places to stay! The room was clean and well-maintained, and the location was very convenient—close to major attractions and transport options. The staff and owner were extremely polite and always ready to help. We stayed for two months and had access to all the necessary facilities, including a fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, TV, and Wi-Fi—everything you could ask for. Daily cleaning service was an added bonus. The check-in and check-out process was smooth and hassle-free. Overall, it was a very pleasant experience, and I would gladly stay here again. Thanks Arpit!

featured_reviews.name: Vee Kay
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a really pleasant and wonderful stay at Florastays Service Apartment. The place is very well connected and really close to the Western Express Highway. The apartment was clean, well maintained and furnished beautifully. The caretaker was always available to help in case needed. This is one of the best service apartments in the western suburbs. I’ll definitely be staying here again during my next visit.

featured_reviews.name: Anshul Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I stayed at this 1-bedroom apartment near TATA MEMORIAL HOSPITAL managed by 29 Bungalow (Arpit D. and team), and overall the experience was a mix of positives and concerns.

First, I want to acknowledge that the management team is professional, responsive, and organized. The apartment itself is well-maintained, relatively new, and a decent size by Mumbai standards (around 400–600 sq ft). It was equipped with essentials like towels, toiletries, utensils, an extra bed, and a comfortable sleeping setup - so from an internal comfort standpoint, it delivers well.

However, there are two major issues that significantly impact the experience:
1. Location (specific to Ruparel Nova, Bhoiwada):
The property is situated in a highly congested area, surrounded by what feels like a slum-like locality. Access is difficult through narrow, crowded lanes, and the overall surroundings can be quite off-putting, especially for someone not familiar with the area. While it is very close to Tata Memorial Hospital - which gives it strong long-term potential - the current environment does not justify the premium positioning.
2. Pricing:
The per-day cost feels quite high for what the location offers. While Mumbai is expensive, the pricing does not align well with the external conditions of the property. It gives the impression that the apartments may remain vacant often due to this mismatch. A more volume-driven and affordable pricing strategy could improve occupancy and contribute to better long-term value.

Overall, the stay was comfortable from an apartment and service perspective, and the professionalism of the managing team is commendable. However, the location and pricing are significant drawbacks.
My rating: 3/5

There is definite potential here, but improvements in pricing alignment (and possibly expectation-setting around the location) would make a big difference.

featured_reviews.name: Sahil Bangera
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kach Karkhana CHS is an average housing society that offers a decent living experience overall. The location is quite convenient, with basic shops, markets, and public transport options nearby, which makes day-to-day life easier for most residents. However, the internal maintenance and cleanliness could be improved. The common areas sometimes look neglected, and garbage disposal isn’t always done on time.

The society has basic amenities like parking space and security guards, but both could use better management. Visitors’ parking is limited, and sometimes residents face minor issues with water supply during peak hours. The security staff are polite, though not always very attentive.

Community-wise, most neighbours are cooperative and friendly, which helps maintain a peaceful environment. The committee does make efforts to organize small gatherings and maintenance drives, though communication with residents could be more transparent and regular.

Overall, Kach Karkhana CHS is a decent option if you’re looking for an affordable and convenient place to stay, but it still has room for improvement in terms of upkeep and facilities. With some consistent management efforts, it has the potential to become a much better residential society in the area.
